scope: Fifteen selected actual native CG images personally viewed against the current individual V2 original-project source and their final scene briefs.

entries.observations: Source-bound Orin V2: navy scarf/hair and coat, ochre torn lining, dark layered clothes, brass hardware, RIGHT gauntlet/two pendants and LEFT-thigh vial carrier preserved. LEFT normal glove rests on the pouch. Full boots/hands/coat ends inside image. Quiet lookout on stone walkway with blue crystal lamps at golden hour, distinct from the source raised-hand laboratory pose. Exact tiny gauntlet/reverse-coat geometry remains source-limited.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Debout de trois quarts, poids sur la jambe gauche, gantelet droit abaissé et main gauche posée sur la pochette de cuisse ; regard vers la droite.

entries.observations: A genuinely corrected RIGHT-hand palm faces the viewer with thumb on viewer right and exactly five articulated digits. Hollow cuff/no wearer or human body, brass/black structure, vertical cyan capsule and two blue pendant flasks preserved. The gauntlet is upright on a wooden stand, matching the final actual brief. Glassmaker workbench and warm window differ from every character scene. Hidden mechanism and tiny casing dimensions remain source-limited.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Gantelet droit vide dressé verticalement sur un support en bois, paume vers le spectateur et pouce à droite ; deux pendants bleus au poignet.

entries.observations: Empty frontal library/loggia and garden-balcony view, wisteria, brass apparatus/book, purple/navy-gold civic arcana, floating citadels and waterfalls. No character body, silhouette, portrait or humanoid statue. Distinct daytime library setting; viewpoint matches the actual revised brief. Environment-only scene does not supply new identity evidence.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Vue depuis un balcon vide à hauteur de regard ; aucune présence humaine ou reflet de personnage.

entries.observations: Seated three-quarter apothecary study. Attached RIGHT mechanical hand rests on the table; normal LEFT hand pours a blue vial. Corrected LEFT-thigh flask carrier is on the far left leg, opposite the foreground RIGHT gauntlet. Full boots, stool-side body and coat ends contained. Sunlit community glass-roof market differs from the other settings. Actual three-quarter seated brief is checked, not the earlier strict-profile intention.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Assis de trois quarts sur un tabouret, main gauche versant un flacon bleu dans une coupelle, gantelet droit ouvert posé à côté.

entries.observations: Low action lunge with anatomical LEFT knee forward, RIGHT gold gauntlet reaching down to cyan ground effect, normal LEFT hand extended back. LEFT-thigh flask carrier clearly on forward left leg; two RIGHT forearm pendants visible. Both feet, hands and coat contained. Shattered threshold junction and floating broken stonework differ from the other reviewed settings; Nexus label correctly separates this game action from source-canon power claims.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Fente basse, jambe gauche pliée en avant, gantelet droit tendu vers un cercle cyan au sol, bras gauche écarté en équilibre.

entries.observations: Descending three-quarter stance, anatomical RIGHT boot on lower step, normal LEFT hand holding coat/scarf collar, RIGHT gauntlet relaxed beside body; LEFT-thigh carrier remains on the opposite side from gauntlet. Full boots and coat tails inside frame. Crystal-lit stairway with canvas sails/banners reads as an outdoor arcane caravan station, distinct from lookout/library/shattered crossroads.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Descend une marche de trois quarts face, pied droit posé plus bas, gantelet droit près de la hanche et main gauche retenant le col du manteau.

entries.observations: RIGHT gauntlet raised at shoulder level with the DORSAL hand surface visible and five fingers; normal LEFT fist rests on hip, LEFT-thigh carrier remains on the opposite side. Final pose explicitly records the observed dorsal view rather than claiming the originally requested palm. Reverse gauntlet microconstruction is not established by one source portrait. Full body/coat and both boots contained. Memory orchard and clearing golden sky are distinct.
entries.poseBriefChecked: Debout jambes rapprochées, gantelet droit levé à hauteur d’épaule, doigts ouverts avec dos de la main visible ; poing gauche sur la hanche et tête légèrement inclinée.

entries.observations: True reframing now contains the formerly clipped LEFT coat panel and the other coat tail. Seated on cistern steps in rain, LEFT knee raised, RIGHT gauntlet on RIGHT thigh, normal LEFT hand at temple; corrected LEFT-thigh carrier remains on the raised LEFT leg. Full boots and visible hands contained. Recovery/defeat gesture differs from seated apothecary work and every standing pose.

RIGHT gauntlet stays at raised RIGHT knee; normal LEFT index traces pebbles while LEFT knee is down. LEFT-thigh flask carrier remains correct. Both bare feet and character body contained; removed coat can be partly occluded or off the accessory edge. Coastal stone arch and bright cove differ from urban settings. Fan Art wardrobe change is explicit, no age claim.

Incorrect RIGHT-thigh carrier was removed; actual LEFT carrier is naturally hidden under apron and is not falsely claimed visible. Full boots, coat ends, tray/teapot and hands contained. Night glass tea salon is distinct from daylight library, market or ruined crossroads.

RIGHT gauntlet is the far arm reaching forward to desk, normal LEFT arm remains behind back; LEFT-side vial carrier is on the near outer hip. Navy/gold identity and alchemical equipment retained, added uniform formality stays What If. Both boots and coat contained; high lightning-lit civic office differs from other settings. Tiny incidental marks are not approved source text or franchise insignia.

Rear three-quarter pose looks over anatomical RIGHT shoulder toward viewer; RIGHT gauntlet rests on balustrade and normal LEFT hand hangs on opposite side. Incorrect RIGHT carrier is removed; LEFT carrier is concealed behind the coat rather than moved. Two RIGHT forearm pendants remain. Full boots and coat ends contained. Night mirror-water promenade and two fantasy moons are original setting composition, not an official screenshot.

Shuffling short step/head tilt and left hand held before chest differ from stair descent and service walk. Whole body/boots/coat contained. Abandoned ivy glasshouse and moonlight are distinct from the civic office and living apothecary.

LEFT knee down and RIGHT knee raised; RIGHT gauntlet examines herbs above mortar while normal LEFT hand holds open notebook. LEFT-thigh carrier stays at LEFT upper thigh. True reframing contains all coat hem tips and visible boots; kneeling body differs in hand tasks/torso from the beach kneel. Rustic school herb garden is distinct from market, cove and city terrace.

sourceLimitations: Selected HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait are the same V2 original-project bitmap; internal authority, not an external official source.

One portrait does not establish exact iris color, reverse garment/gauntlet construction, tiny jewellery geometry or chronological age. Preserve restrained continuations without claiming perfect1:1 certification.

New Aetherion places and poses are original compositions respecting seven measurable laws: form, cost, bond, memory, exchange, threshold, contradiction; blue and amber magic does not establish limitless canon powers.
CG05 is Nexus;09-11FanArt;12-15WhatIf. FirstStep at the same apparent age is a hypothetical first expedition, not an invented childhood.
Old atlas remains unchanged as a variant; current reference has large RIGHT gold gauntlet, navy scarf, ochre lining and flasks missing in old atlas.
reviewLimits: Source provides one pose and does not establish tiny exact iris, rear garment or reverse gauntlet construction.
CG07 actual dorsal hand view is accepted as a new restrained view with limits; it is not certified as the originally requested source-facing palm.
Occluded LEFT-thigh carriers in service/back-view scenes are not claimed visibly established. A source RIGHT belt flask is distinguished from the LEFT-thigh carrier.
The fifteen scene roles and source anatomy were visually compared. Hashes/dimensions alone do not certify likeness or pose variation.
